fusions.name: Slow Swell
fusions.desc: Pushes a slow swell through a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, which deals 11 damage to everything in it, knocks them back 3 tiles and leaves them [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: In Its Own Time
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy blow that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: No Great Hurry
fusions.desc: Removes up to 4 conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Smooth Is Fast
fusions.desc: While you are at full health, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
